nightlyRechargeResults.sleepTip: What a dreadful night! If you can, make up for lost sleep tonight. Set the stage for a good night's sleep by consciously winding down before bedtime. Do something you know relaxes you to improve the quality of your sleep.
nightlyRechargeResults.vitalityTip: Take a nap, if you like. A power nap of no more than 20-30 minutes might do the trick. The best remedy for low energy levels today is reserving some time for rest.
nightlyRechargeResults.exerciseTip: Consider taking a day off from training. Or do just a little light exercise.
